study_overview:
Brief Summary

            This is a Phase 1/2, multicenter, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics (PK), and pharmacodynamics (PD) of single and multiple doses of DNL593 in two parts followed by an optional open-label extension (OLE) period.

            Part A will evaluate the safety, tolerability, PK, and PD of single doses of DNL593 in healthy male and healthy female participants of nonchildbearing potential. Part B will evaluate the safety, tolerability, PK, and PD of multiple doses of DNL593 in participants with frontotemporal dementia (FTD) over 25 weeks. Part B will be followed by Part C, an optional 18-month OLE period available for all participants who complete Part B.
            Official Title
            A Phase 1/2, Multicenter, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Double Blind Single Dose and Multiple Dose Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics of DNL593 in Healthy Participants and Participants With Frontotemporal Dementia Followed by an Open-Label Extension
            Conditions
            Frontotemporal Dementia
            Intervention / Treatment

                Drug: DNL593
                Drug: Placebo

            Sponsor: Denali Therapeutics

emails.subject: NGX-PD-201: Scheduling Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) #3 - Site 105
emails.body:
Hi Maria,

I hope you are well.

I'm writing to schedule the next routine Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) for the NGX-PD-201 study at St. Mary's Neurological Institute. I am proposing a 2-day visit during the last week of November.

My available dates are:
- November 27-28
- November 29-30

Please let me know which of these dates would work best for you and Dr. Evans. 

Key activities for this visit will include 100% SDV for the first three participants enrolled in Part B, review of the ISF, and drug accountability. I have attached a draft agenda for your review.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

Alex Johnson
Clinical Research Associate
NeuroGenix Pharma
alex.johnson@neurogenixpharma.com

emails.subject: URGENT: Significant Protocol Deviation - Dosing Error - Study INP456 - Site 303 - Pt 303-005
emails.body:
Dear Alex,

I am writing to urgently report a significant protocol deviation that occurred today for participant 303-005, enrolled in Part B of the INP456 study.

This morning during their daily check-in call, the participant reported that they inadvertently took a double dose of the investigational product (two tablets instead of the prescribed one tablet).

The participant is currently asymptomatic and reports feeling well. Our PI, Dr. Miller, has been notified and has spoken with the participant directly. We have instructed the participant to self-monitor closely and report any new or worsening symptoms immediately.

We are initiating a Protocol Deviation form. Could you please provide immediate guidance on the next steps for documentation and any additional safety monitoring procedures we should implement? We need to confirm the appropriate reporting timelines and if any other forms are required at this stage.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this serious matter.

Best regards,

Sarah Chen
Study Coordinator
Maplewood Clinical Research Center
(555) 123-4567

threads.description: A thread initiated by the Study Coordinator at Site 303 regarding a significant protocol deviation. A participant in Part B accidentally took a double dose of the investigational product. Alex Johnson provides immediate guidance on documenting the event, completing a protocol deviation form, and ensuring the participant is monitored closely for any adverse effects, looping in the study's Medical Monitor for clinical oversight.

emails.subject: URGENT: Temperature Excursion - DNL593 Study - Site 105
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Hope you are well.

This morning we discovered a temperature excursion in the investigational product refrigerator at our pharmacy. The excursion occurred overnight.

- Study: DNL593
- Site: 105 - UCSF Medical Center
- Excursion Start: Approx. 2023-10-25 22:00 PST
- Excursion End: 2023-10-26 06:00 PST
- Recorded Min/Max Temp: -1.5°C / 9.5°C (storage range is 2-8°C)
- Affected Product: All DNL593 and placebo vials currently in stock.

I have attached the continuous temperature monitoring log for your review. Please advise on the next steps and whether the product integrity may be compromised. The stock is currently being held in the fridge, but we have not used any for dispensing this morning.

Best regards,

Sarah Miller, RPh
Pharmacist
UCSF Medical Center Pharmacy
